newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian dies of drugs overdose in AIDS unit.
newsitem.headline: Italian dies of drugs overdose in AIDS unit.

text.p: An Italian died and two others needed emergency medical treatment on Wednesday after overdosing on heroin in the AIDS unit of a hospital in the southern city of Naples, police said.

The death of AIDS sufferer Giovanni Manzo, 35, at Cotugno Hospital followed a protest on Tuesday by another patient in the unit who set fire to sheets and a mattress to draw attention to what he alleged was open access to patients for drugs pushers.
Police said Manzo and two other patients, who were revived by doctors, had injected themselves with heroin in the bathroom of Manzo's room.
It was not clear whether a visitor had brought in the drug or one of the three had left the unit to buy it, police said.
The patient who staged Tuesday's protest told reporters Manzo had gone out to buy the heroin.
"This time the overdose cases have come to light but since I've been here I've seen at least 10. Drugs get in here and you can come and go as you please," he said.
Police called a meeting for Thursday to discuss security at the hospital, the largest centre for the treatment of infectious diseases in southern Italy.
